structured.answer: Almost everything on this page is marked "לא מחושב". That includes the things close to me: structured deposits, foreign-currency and dollar-linked deposits, Bonds, company bonds, manager's insurance and savings policies. The site says it won't calculate any of them until the rules are checked, so I won't rely on it for a decision and will ask my son or the bank.

stuck.why: The first cards were ETC and LBMA Gold, English letters, and I almost felt the page wasn't for me
Codes like TX2-01 and crossed-out 'נסגר ב־' dates; I didn't understand what was closed and what was still open
Tired: dark page, many cards and many small grey lines

used: Title 'מה האתר עוד לא מכסה' and its subtitle
Red box: 'עד שייסגרו, האתר לא מחשב אותם'
Red 'לא מחושב' tags on every card
Card names and the 'מה ידוע' lines: פיקדון מובנה, מוצר מובנה, פיקדון במטבע זר, צמוד דולר, מענק, אגרת בונדס, אג"ח קונצרניות, ביטוח מנהלים, פוליסת חיסכון
Open questions in the deposit and savings-policy cards
skipped: Law references and source links in blue/grey
not_found: An ordinary plain bank deposit in the list (at least not in the first six screens)
A simple sentence saying which things the site DOES calculate
Anything about whether the bank takes too much in fees on my deposits

findings.what: Small grey text on a black background is hard to read, even enlarged
findings.where: Source lines, dates and 'כשייסגר' notes on all cards

findings.what: The page opens with English-lettered products (ETC, LBMA Gold), which made me feel it wasn't for me
Every card has a red 'לא מחושב' tag, which feels alarming and makes them all look alike
Codes and crossed-out dates mean nothing to me
Long list with no grouping by what matters to me (deposits vs. shares vs. insurance)
No summary of how many items there are or which of them the site does cover
